content: The WHATWG HTML EventSource specification says a browser reconnects after a broken SSE connection and sends Last-Event-ID when the last dispatched event had an id field; comment-only blocks are valid keepalives and do not dispatch messages. An event must end with a blank line to dispatch. Therefore a reconnecting local UI needs an application-level current-state snapshot or replay keyed by round identity; SSE comments alone keep a connection alive but cannot restore a missed state transition. The repository currently sends a snapshot on connect, 25-second comment pings, and client-side exponential backoff with jitter, but it does not use SSE event id/Last-Event-ID, so a snapshot/round-id contract remains the right recovery invariant. Cross-checked with the current WHATWG HTML server-sent-events page and MDN search results.
